content:
maria: Heads-up — planning announcement for 2026-08-18 10:00am PT. Need one canonical changelog link, docs anchor, and rollout cadence by EOD. Also webinar assets and lead-tagging.

leo: Well do staggered rollout: EU canary 09:30 PT (5%), then US ramp 09:50 -> 100% by 10:00 if metrics OK. Ops threshold: hold if p95 > 2x baseline or errors >0.8% for 3m.

anya: Docs PR is up: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/981 — waiting on perf blurb for the hero.

maria: Marketing needs a one-line headline + one supporting stat for the post. Short and punchy.

leo: Draft: "New batching + cache warmup cuts median latency ~22% and lowers per-1k token cost ~20%." Ill confirm numbers and paste into docs PR.

ops-bot: Release window created: 2026-08-18T16:30:00Z -> 2026-08-18T17:15:00Z. Runbook: /runbooks/releases/2026-08-18.

salesops: CRM tag = "aug_release_2026". SLA: 48h response. Add hidden tag on forms and webhook.

maria: Please ping when changelog is merged + docs anchor live + webhook test passes — marketing will gate the publish on ops green. Thanks all.
